slides.title: Coming soon: AI security
slides.summary: How AI systems that read untrusted text and use tools get attacked, and how to defend them. This chapter is on its way.
body: Once a model reads untrusted text and can use tools, attackers can talk to it too. This chapter covers how AI systems get attacked, and how to defend them.

ul: Prompt injection, typed in or hidden in documents
Data leaks through tools and links
The “lethal trifecta”: private data, untrusted content and a way to send data out
